name: session-graph
description: A knowledge graph across your Claude Code sessions. Each session records its topics and files; when another session covers the same ground you get an alert, and /graph can pull its findings into the one you are in.

model.title: Topic model
model.description: The model that names each session's topics after a turn. Default claude-haiku-5-5, the cheapest. A blank value uses the default.

sensitivity.title: Match sensitivity
sensitivity.description: How much two sessions must share before they are linked. strict: 3 shared topics, or a shared file plus 2 topics. normal: 2 shared topics, or a shared file plus 1 topic. loose: any 1 shared topic. A blank value uses normal.

windowDays.title: Look back (days)
windowDays.description: Default 7. Sessions last active longer ago than this are not compared. A blank value uses the default.

folder.title: Shared folder
folder.description: Every session writes its topics here as one small file, and reads the others'. A blank value uses ~/.claude/session-graph. Use the same folder on every session you want linked.
